modalLead: Long categories stay tidy, the config page lines up with the dashboard, and new installs start on a darker theme with a leaner set of starter bookmarks.

items.text: Items per category — a category now shows only its first 15 bookmarks by default, with the rest tucked behind a per-category + N more / show less toggle, so one big category no longer towers over the others. Change the limit (or turn it off) under Config → General → Layout. This is on by default, so existing long categories are capped after this update; smart collections are never affected, and expanding a category is remembered.

Config header lines up with the dashboard — the Configuration page now uses the same top bar as the dashboard, inbox, and health views, and the configuration title matches their size, so switching between them no longer makes the page jump. The save row and tabs read as one seamless bar.
Midnight Ink is the default theme — a fresh install now starts on the near-black Midnight Ink theme (following your system for light/dark). Existing dashboards keep whatever theme you already chose.
Leaner starter bookmarks — a brand-new install no longer seeds the Tech category or its Unraid and Phoronix bookmarks. Your existing bookmarks are untouched.
